=== simple package
package p1 {
  class A
}
=== nested
package shop {
  package model {
    class Order
  }
  class Cart
}
class Out
=== package as
package "Long Name" as LN {
  class A
}
package LN2 as Short {
}

}
=== package colors url tags

}

}

}

}

}
+ package p6 {
}

{
  class A
}

}

=== namespaces
namespace n1 {
  class A
}
namespace n1.n2 {
  class B
}
namespace "Disp" as n3 {
}
namespace n4 {}
namespace n5 <<Node>> #red {
}
namespace n6 <<st>> [[http://x]] {
}
namespace n7 <<Cloud>> #back:blue {}
=== namespace exists
class n1
namespace n1 {}
=== set separator
set separator ::
class a::b::C
class x.y
=== set separator none
set separator none
class a.b.C
package p.q {
  class d.E
}
=== set namespaceseparator
set namespaceseparator /
class a/b/C
=== separator backslashes
set separator \\
class a\\b\\C
=== phantom groups
class a.b.C
class a.b.D
class a.E
a.b.C --> a.E
=== packing
!pragma useIntermediatePackages false
package a {
  package b {
    package c {
      class X
    }
  }
}
=== packing with separator none
!pragma useIntermediatePackages false
set separator none
package a.x {
  package b {
    class X
  }
}
=== together
together {
  class A
  class B
}
class C
together {
  class D
  together {
    class E
  }
}
=== together in package
package p {
  together {
    class A
  }
}
=== close too much
class A
}
=== unclosed package
package p {
  class A
=== reuse in package
class A
package p {
  A --> B
  class C
}
C --> A
=== package link
package p1 {
}
package p2 {
}
p1 --> p2
=== class into package
package p {
class Q
}
class p.R
=== legend in package
package p {
  legend
  inner legend
  endlegend
}
legend top
outer
endlegend
